title: positionBody assembles the position body of a resolved scope key
summary: @inventarch/runtime exports positionBody(handle, within, resolved) from the package root and the new @inventarch/runtime/internal/position subpath, with the PositionBody, LoadedEntry, LoadedPlace, LoadedRecord, PositionRecord, PositionPointer, PositionVia, PointerTally, FrontierTally, PositionUnknown, PositionCounts and PositionWidening types. Given a key that resolveScopeKey resolved through the scope token within, it returns body(K), {format: ia.position-body.v1, revision, key, seat, loaded, rules, pointers, pointerTallies, frontier, unknowns, counts, widening}, reading only through that token and writing nothing; a missing token is IA-RUNTIME-REQUEST-INVALID. The composition at cost 0 is the seat's field references both ways, a `@workspace` seat's capture members, a `@system` seat's word members, and a location's declared-at record and claimants. The seeds are the seat and the composition records in the shape's kind or lane focus; hops follow directed-view edge rows (never field references) whose predicate is in the shape's focus, in either direction, up to depth, and a row that carries a condition is followed only where the condition holds at the key's coordinate (its shape and phase with the derived category and primitive), read as graph traversal reads it for that coordinate, the condition's severity, provenance and artifact-set terms from the record that states the row; a row that does not hold is no hop, primes no record and names no pointer or frontier record, so the phase can change what loads (decision conditional-relations-in-delivery). The conformance corpus's law `enforced-by @check instance-schema-check when phase is act and severity is blocking` reaches the check at act only. The seat's workspace is the seat when it is a `@workspace`, else the first of the repository's own `@workspace` and the workspace whose declared root holds the seat record whose closure holds that record, so a floor or adopted record, an installed `@system` included, is seated in the repository's workspace with the records the repository authors, even when the installed or adopted `@workspace` that ships it declares the root it sits in. A workspace's closure is the floor and adopted records plus the members of its declared roots or, while it declares no sources, every record whose root no workspace declares, which unknowns names (workspace declares no sources); when neither workspace's closure holds the seat record, no workspace holds the seat, the closure is that fallback and unknowns names it (no `@workspace` holds the seat). A record in another workspace's declared root is never entered and is a pointer naming that workspace. Blocking governance among the candidates other than the seat is reserved in rules before the budget cuts loaded, so it is delivered at budget 0. loaded is the seat (a location, or a workspace seat no record declares, as {path}) and then the first budget records in the design's total order: governance by prime, band descending, hop, severity and identity, every other shape by band descending, hop, lane and identity. Pointers are the 9-tuple (identity, word, kind, lane, owner system, steward, band, hop, via): the first 48 are listed and the rest tallied per word and owner system; the frontier one hop past loaded is tallied per owner system and kind; a steward is the head.steward of the owner system's `@system` record. With word set, only records of that word load (the seat loads whatever its word), are pointers or are counted in the pointer tallies and the frontier, and a record of another word a hop reaches is followed as a waypoint only; the blocking governance reserved in rules is taken from the candidates without the word, so rules under a word is the body's without it and a word never hides a blocking rule. unknowns name the seat's own unknown, a location nothing claims (on a narrowed scope, that no record in it claims the location), missing sources and, on a whole-workspace scope only, the unresolved-reference and unconsented-row findings on loaded records; a narrowed scope says it reads none. widening gives the key at depth + 1 (absent at depth 2) and the re-seat template {shape, phase, depth 1, budget 16}. The body carries no root path, token, time, capture state or record body. Limits: no Door operation, MACHINE_PROTOCOL row, MCP tool or CLI verb serves the body, so the nine version 1 routes and ia scope are unchanged. @inventarch/graph exports laneOf(record), the lane a record's kind gives it (an authority-facet contract reads authority), which the lane index now uses, unchanged. The @inventarch/db readers add roots(options): the roots the `@workspace` records declare in sources, as frozen {root, placement, workspace} copies, longest first, a root whose declaring workspace the read does not admit pruned; DeclaredRoot is exported as a type.
